headline: ECB and SRB Urge EU Lawmakers to Protect Banking Resilience During Rule Changes
summary: European Central Bank supervisory chief Claudia Buch and Single Resolution Board Chair Dominique Laboureix recommended that EU legislators ensure banking rule changes do not impair financial resilience.
why: Regulatory capital and resolution frameworks govern the stability and risk-bearing capacity of European financial institutions.

impacts.name: European Banking Sector
impacts.why: Proposed changes to European banking rules directly impact capital compliance and institutional stability.
